name: Rosewood Miramar Beach Hotel
positioning: Rosewood Miramar Beach: a beachfront hotel in Montecito, California, with beach houses, bungalows and suites facing the Pacific, several restaurants and bars, and on-site luxury shopping
best_for: Travelers who want to stay right on the beach facing the Pacific
Food lovers who want several restaurants and bars on site, including sushi and a beachfront restaurant
Guests who want to try surfing with local surfers

facts.text: Rosewood Miramar Beach is in Montecito, California.
The accommodation is made up of beach houses, bungalows and suites facing the Pacific Ocean.
The Garden Bungalow Suites sit within landscaped gardens in the center of the estate.
Caruso's serves seasonal menus paired with fine wines and signature cocktails.
The Manor Bar serves literary cocktails in a space with a collection of books and art.
AMA Sushi is led by California-born Chef Scott Yonamine, who has spent two decades honing his craft.
The Revere Room serves California dining.
Miramar Beach Bar is the hotel's beachfront restaurant, serving cocktails and bites.

highlights.text: At FronteMare, the Caruso's team prepares food live along the coastline for guests gathered around a communal table.
The Miramar Surf Club offers surfing alongside local surfers as a taste of Santa Barbara's surf culture.
Luxury brand shops, from CHANEL to Zegna, are on the property within steps of the accommodations.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited availability because of high demand.
